rv.q: Hass delivers an emotionally charged and raw performance as Hedwig, exuding vulnerability, passion, and attitude in every line of storytelling and verse, whether it's a ballad or high-energy song.
Despite a lot of technical difficulties and miscues, Hass holds the audience in close connection with Hedwig, seeking our affection and affirmation amidst the art she creates ad hoc with us.
Personally, however, I don't think I was the target audience. While I appreciated the performances and the music, the overall style simply wasn't for me.
